texts.preamble: Himanshu Kumar Dokania vs The State Of Jharkhand And Anr on 24 March, 2017 Author: Rongon Mukhopadhyay Bench: Rongon Mukhopadhyay
texts.arguments: It has also been submitted that the petitioner has not been given proper opportunity to defend his case as in terms of the Rules 3.1.1(8) the Adjudicating Officer was supposed to intimate the person who was proceeded against or his authorized representative with respect to the offence alleged to have been committed by such person and indicating the provisions of the Act, rules and regulations in support of which the contravention is alleged to have taken place. Learned counsel has also referred to Sub-rule 9 of Rule 3.1.1 which envisages that such person who has been proceeded against has to be given an opportunity to produce such documents or evidence which is relevant for the purpose of the case. It has thus been submitted that the basic tenets of the proceeding against the petitioner under the Act was not followed and in such circumstance, therefore, the impugned order dated 27.01.2017 passed by the Adjudicating Officer-cum- Deputy Commissioner, Dhanbad in Food Safety and Standards Case No. 01 of 2016 deserves to be [LEAKAGE_MASK] and [LEAKAGE_MASK]. At this, Mr. Vijayant Verma, learned J.C. to G. P. - II, submits that he has to take instruction and file a counter affidavit.
texts.petitioner_arguments: It has also been submitted that the petitioner has not been given proper opportunity to defend his case as in terms of the Rules 3.1.1(8) the Adjudicating Officer was supposed to intimate the person who was proceeded against or his authorized representative with respect to the offence alleged to have been committed by such person and indicating the provisions of the Act, rules and regulations in support of which the contravention is alleged to have taken place. Learned counsel has also referred to Sub-rule 9 of Rule 3.1.1 which envisages that such person who has been proceeded against has to be given an opportunity to produce such documents or evidence which is relevant for the purpose of the case. It has thus been submitted that the basic tenets of the proceeding against the petitioner under the Act was not followed and in such circumstance, therefore, the impugned order dated 27.01.2017 passed by the Adjudicating Officer-cum- Deputy Commissioner, Dhanbad in Food Safety and Standards Case No. 01 of 2016 deserves to be [LEAKAGE_MASK] and [LEAKAGE_MASK]. At this, Mr. Vijayant Verma, learned J.C. to G. P. - II, submits that he has to take instruction and file a counter affidavit.
